text: A tool shall advertise a profile as implemented only when its encoder, complete lowering/runtime closure, linker/loader contract, and relevant conformance vectors pass. An unavailable backend shall produce a diagnostic rather than emit code for a nearby CPU. Proposed profile status shall not satisfy this gate.
